text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, 1st place! Crossing the finish 
line first feels amazing, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The stands were super hyped, too! I 
couldn't help but wave my hands like 
crazy~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Monthly Twinkle was here doing 
coverage too! I wonder if I'll get an 
article written about me~?

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if my photo will be included 
too?! If it is, I'm gonna show my big 
sister~♪

text_block_list.text:
Check it out as soon as it goes on sale, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos

That sounds super awesome! A special 
feature issue is way too cool~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it's got tons of pages! I gotta 
go win a whole bunch of races~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I guess I'll need an outfit for the 
interview too. What should I wear~! I'm so 
excited!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna win races so big 
they'll publish a special Vivlos issue 
about me~!
